payload.title: Validate ClayCode foreign-effect closure on Andreas Ubuntu host

work_clay.goal: On the actual Ubuntu developer system, test and minimally prototype a fail-closed Foreign Effect Closure Gate for ClayCode child execution without changing ClayCode semantics unless a concrete representation counterexample is found.
required_surfaces: WASM/WASI child when current toolchain is available
candidate_enforcement_layers: explicit FD allowlist plus close_range/CLOEXEC hygiene
Landlock feature/ABI probing and supported restrictions
seccomp syscall filtering as a layer, never standalone sandbox proof
IPC/network namespace or broker restrictions where required
work_clay.hard_rule: EffectiveEffects(child) must be a subset of parent-granted effects plus separately receipted external grants; any required restriction lacking target-host enforcement coverage must fail closed rather than silently downgrade.

reason_clay.why_now: BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE is active and CC-WP-07 Runtime/ABI/FFI, CC-WP-10 general app suite and CC-WP-11 fuzz/conformance are still open. Hosted execution found concrete inherited-FD and SCM_RIGHTS counterexamples but could not establish target-host Landlock/enforcement truth.

required_outputs: executed inherited-FD and SCM_RIGHTS baseline plus mediated variants
matched ordinary utility checks for representative BASE applications
effect-closure coverage receipt with parent contract hash, child hash, admitted handles, policy hash, host feature coverage, resource budgets, unsupported atoms and external grants
decision whether existing ClayCode G9 semantics can represent the complete contract
completion_clay.pass_condition: No undeclared effect is reached in the declared test matrix, required enforcement atoms are actually covered on the target host, and ordinary utility remains acceptable under explicit grants. A language change is allowed only if a concrete G9 representation counterexample is produced.

evidence_need: LOCAL_EXECUTION_PRIMARY receipt from the Ubuntu developer host

executor_policy.reason: Only the local organ can establish current Ubuntu target-host enforcement truth.

dependencies: latest work specification must be revalidated before effect
invalidators: An equal-or-stronger Ubuntu target-host effect-closure execution receipt already completes the same matrix
Owner changes the Frank v0.1 target host or cancels BASE work
